name: Chalk Hollow
summary: Break the reavers' hold on the quarry road.
startText: North of the marsh is Chalk Hollow, where our stone came from before the reavers took the quarry. Kill eight cutters and bring me eight of their tokens.
inProgressText: Eight chalk cutters, and eight reaver tokens.
completionText: They will feel that. Tonics, and the Ford's thanks.
